question: Acute Stress Disorder (ASD) and Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) share the same core symptom clusters; the primary distinguishing feature is the TIME elapsed since the traumatic event.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is TRUE. ASD and PTSD share the same core symptom clusters. The critical distinction is the duration: ASD occurs within 3 days to 1 month after trauma; PTSD is diagnosed when the same symptoms persist beyond 1 month. Do not use symptom type alone to differentiate them.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. ASD and PTSD have overlapping symptom clusters (re-experiencing, avoidance, hyperarousal, negative cognitions). The key distinction is temporal: ASD = symptoms within 3 days to 1 month of trauma; PTSD = symptoms lasting more than 1 month.
